C0484.title: Minors Bypass Game Real-Name Verification via Purchased QQ Accounts
C0484.summary: On October 30, 2023, a mobile game minor protection assessment revealed that minors could bypass real-name verification by logging into games with purchased QQ accounts, leveraging the adult identity information of the original account holders. This flaw directly circumvented the identity recognition mechanism of the game's anti-addiction system.

references.title: Mobile game minor evaluation released! QQ has vulnerability allowing minors to bypass real-name verification - Tencent News
